tagline.en: Two franchise tunnels and the bypass between them, built in five years for East Kowloon and Sha Tin
tagline.zh: 两条专营隧道和夹在中间的绕道，五年内为九龙东和沙田建成

start.en: The Island Eastern Corridor (Route 4) at Quarry Bay, on Hong Kong Island
start.zh: 香港岛鲗鱼涌，接东区走廊（4号干线）

end.en: The Tolo Highway (Route 9) at Ma Liu Shui, by the Chinese University in Sha Tin
end.zh: 沙田马料水，近香港中文大学，接吐露港公路（9号干线）

en: Route 2 is about 18.8 km of mostly expressway from Quarry Bay on Hong Kong Island to Ma Liu Shui in Sha Tin. It is four roads in sequence: the Eastern Harbour Crossing under the eastern end of Victoria Harbour, the Kwun Tong Bypass on viaduct along the Kowloon Bay waterfront, the Tate's Cairn Tunnel through the hills behind Diamond Hill, and the Tate's Cairn Highway along the east side of Sha Tin to the Tolo Highway.

It is the eastern counterpart of Route 1, and it was built as the relief for it: a second crossing of the harbour and a second way between Kowloon and Sha Tin, both opened within two years. The busiest part is the Kwun Tong Bypass between Wai Yip Street and Kowloon Bay, where traffic for the harbour tunnel, the Tseung Kwan O tunnels and Route 5 all meet.
zh: 2号干线长约 18.8 公里，大部分为快速公路，由港岛鲗鱼涌通往沙田马料水。它由四条道路依次连成：维港东端海底的东区海底隧道、沿九龙湾海旁高架而行的观塘绕道、在钻石山背后穿山而过的大老山隧道，以及沿沙田东侧通往吐露港公路的大老山公路。
它是 1号干线在东面的对应线，建造目的正是为 1号干线分流：一条新的过海通道，加上一条新的九龙至沙田通道，两者在两年内相继启用。全线最繁忙的路段是伟业街至九龙湾一段观塘绕道，过海隧道、将军澳方向隧道和 5号干线的车流在此交汇。

en: The Eastern Harbour Crossing was the first tunnel in Hong Kong to carry both road and railway. Its fifteen immersed-tube units, laid in three batches, hold two road tubes, two MTR tubes — now used by the Tseung Kwan O line — and a services gallery between the road bores. The units were cast in a dry dock at Cha Kwo Ling, on the site of the toll plaza and a former quarry next to it; when each batch was finished the dock was flooded and the units floated out and towed along the line of the tunnel. The last unit was placed on 15 September 1988 and the tunnel was holed through that October.

The Tate's Cairn Tunnel is about 3.9 km of twin two-lane bores. A shorter alignment emerging at To Shek in Sha Tin was considered and dropped because of poor ground there; the chosen route comes out at Siu Lek Yuen. When it opened in 1991 it was the longest road tunnel in Hong Kong, and stayed so for almost 28 years. One of its ventilation buildings, at Lok Wah Street, is joined to the main bores by a branch tunnel so as not to disturb a cemetery above.
The 5.2 km Kwun Tong Bypass is an elevated expressway with three lanes each way. Its second phase was built with precast concrete deck slabs, which brought it in a month early.
zh: 东区海底隧道是香港第一条同时设有行车道和铁路的隧道。十五节沉管分三批安放，内含两条行车管道、两条港铁管道（今由将军澳线使用），以及行车管道之间一条设备管廊。沉管在茶果岭的干船坞铸造，船坞位于收费广场及其旁边的前石矿场；每批沉管完成后，船坞注水打开闸门，沉管浮起后由趸船沿隧道走线拖至定位。最后一节沉管于 1988 年 9 月 15 日安放，同年 10 月隧道贯通。
大老山隧道全长约 3.9 公里，为双管双线。当局曾考虑在沙田多石出口的较短方案，因当地地质问题而放弃，最终出口设于小沥源。隧道 1991 年启用时是全港最长的行车隧道，此纪录保持了近 28 年。位于乐华街的通风大楼以一条分支隧道接驳主隧道，以免影响上方的坟场。
观塘绕道全长 5.2 公里，为三线双程的高架快速公路。第二期采用预制混凝土桥面板施工，提早一个月完成。

en: By the late 1970s the Cross-Harbour Tunnel was saturated, and the government studied a second crossing. The first idea was a bridge at Lei Yue Mun, from Shau Kei Wan to Yau Tong, which was dropped because it would interfere with Kai Tak airport and with shipping through the Lei Yue Mun channel. In the early 1980s it was replaced by a tunnel from Quarry Bay to Cha Kwo Ling, tendered in 1984 as a franchise that could include a railway. The New Hong Kong Tunnel Company — CITIC Pacific, Kumagai Gumi, Paul Y and Marubeni — won it in December 1985. Work began on 25 September 1986, and Governor David Wilson drove the first car through on 21 September 1989, four months early. Prince Charles formally opened it that November.

Traffic between Kowloon and Sha Tin had been growing about 12% a year since 1977, and Lion Rock Tunnel could take no more. The Tate's Cairn Tunnel was planned from 1986, and building it meant clearing the squatter areas around Ngau Chi Wan and Diamond Hill; 15,000 to 20,000 people were rehoused. Construction began in 1988 and the tunnel opened on the evening of 26 June 1991, more than a month ahead of the target date. On its first day traffic through Lion Rock fell by a fifth.

The Kwun Tong Bypass tied the two together. It was proposed in 1985 by the Eastern Harbour Crossing's franchisee, which built the first phase, Lei Yue Mun Road to Wai Yip Street, on the government's behalf; it opened with the tunnel in 1989. The second phase opened on 14 June 1991 and the last link, to the Tate's Cairn Tunnel, with the tunnel twelve days later. The whole line was Route 6 until 2004, when the third numbering system renamed it Route 2 without changing its roads.
zh: 到 1970 年代后期，红磡海底隧道已经饱和，政府开始研究第二条过海通道。最初的构想是在鲤鱼门建跨海大桥，连接筲箕湾与油塘，后因会影响启德机场运作和船只进出鲤鱼门海峡而放弃。1980 年代初改为由鲗鱼涌至茶果岭的海底隧道，1984 年以可兼设铁路的专营权形式招标。由中信泰富、熊谷组、保华及丸红组成的新香港隧道有限公司于 1985 年 12 月中标。1986 年 9 月 25 日动工，1989 年 9 月 21 日港督卫奕信驾车率先驶过，比原定提早四个月；同年 11 月由查理斯王子主持揭幕。
九龙至沙田之间的车流自 1977 年起每年增长约 12%，狮子山隧道已无法再承受。大老山隧道自 1986 年起规划；修建它需要清拆牛池湾、钻石山一带的寮屋区，约 1.5 万至 2 万人迁入公屋。隧道于 1988 年动工，1991 年 6 月 26 日晚上通车，比原定日期早一个多月。通车首日，狮子山隧道车流下降两成。
观塘绕道把两者连在一起。它由东区海底隧道的专营公司于 1985 年提出，第一期（鲤鱼门道至伟业街）亦由该公司代政府兴建，1989 年与隧道同日通车。第二期于 1991 年 6 月 14 日通车，接驳大老山隧道的最后一段则在十二天后与隧道同时启用。整条路线在 2004 年前编为 6 号干线，第三代编号系统实施时改称 2号干线，组成路段不变。

en: Both tunnels were build–operate–transfer projects, financed entirely by private companies in return for 30-year franchises to collect tolls. The Eastern Harbour Crossing was reported to have cost HK$3.4 billion; the developer also received the right to build housing over the Quarry Bay and Lam Tin stations. The Tate's Cairn Tunnel, built by a Gammon–Nishimatsu joint venture whose company was 39.5% owned by Cross-Harbour (Holdings), cost HK$1.96 billion according to Chinese Wikipedia and HK$2.15 billion according to a 1999 World Bank report, which says technical difficulties doubled the final cost. The Kwun Tong Bypass was a government road, though its first phase was built by the tunnel company.

The franchises have all run out. The Eastern Harbour Crossing's railway tunnel passed to the government in 2008; its road tunnel followed on 7 August 2016. The Tate's Cairn Tunnel was handed over on 11 July 2018. Before then, toll rises under the franchise terms had been politically contentious — in 2005 an Eastern Harbour Crossing increase from HK$15 to HK$25 for cars drew criticism of the franchise model for pushing traffic back to the Cross-Harbour Tunnel.
zh: 两条隧道都是“建造、营运、移交”项目，全部由私营公司出资，换取 30 年收费专营权。东区海底隧道据报道建费 34 亿港元；发展商另获鲗鱼涌站及蓝田站上盖物业发展权。大老山隧道由金门与西松联营兴建，隧道公司由港通控股持股 39.5%，造价据中文维基百科为 19.6 亿港元，据世界银行 1999 年报告为 21.5 亿港元，该报告称技术困难令最终造价翻了一番。观塘绕道属政府道路，但第一期由隧道公司代建。
各专营权均已届满。东隧铁路隧道于 2008 年交还政府，行车隧道于 2016 年 8 月 7 日交还；大老山隧道于 2018 年 7 月 11 日移交政府。此前按专营条款的加价一直具争议性——2005 年东隧私家车收费由 15 元加至 25 元，被批评专营模式把车流推回红磡海底隧道。

en: Both tunnels are limited to 70 km/h; the Kwun Tong Bypass is 80 km/h in its middle section and 70 at each end. Since 2023 both tunnels have used HKeToll, without toll booths. The Kwun Tong Bypass and most of the Tate's Cairn Highway are designated expressways; the two tunnels and Lei Yue Mun Road are not.
zh: 两条隧道限速均为每小时 70 公里；观塘绕道中段限速 80 公里，两端 70 公里。两条隧道自 2023 年起采用“易通行”，不设收费亭。观塘绕道和大部分大老山公路属法定快速公路；两条隧道及鲤鱼门道则不是。

why.en: No figure is published for the route as a whole: its parts were paid for separately by two tunnel franchisees and the government. The tunnel costs are listed below.
why.zh: 整条路线没有公布总造价：各段分别由两家隧道专营公司和政府出资。各隧道造价分列如下。

value.en: Private build–operate–transfer franchises for both tunnels — the New Hong Kong Tunnel Company (Eastern Harbour Crossing, 1986–2016) and the Tate's Cairn Tunnel Company (1988–2018); the Kwun Tong Bypass and Tate's Cairn Highway were government roads
value.zh: 两条隧道均以私人“建造、营运、移交”专营权兴建——新香港隧道有限公司（东区海底隧道，1986—2016 年）与大老山隧道有限公司（1988—2018 年）；观塘绕道及大老山公路为政府道路

figures.source: English Wikipedia, Eastern Harbour Crossing, Tate's Cairn Tunnel, Kwun Tong Bypass; Chinese Wikipedia, 东区海底隧道, 大老山隧道

value.en: Reported at HK$3.4 billion at opening in 1989 (road and rail tunnel together)
value.zh: 1989 年通车时报道建费 34 亿港元（行车与铁路隧道合计）

figures.source: 华侨日报, 26 September 1986 and 22 September 1989, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 东区海底隧道

value.en: HK$1.96 billion (Chinese Wikipedia) or HK$2.15 billion (World Bank). The two sources disagree and their scope is not stated.
value.zh: 19.6 亿港元（中文维基百科）或 21.5 亿港元（世界银行）。两个来源不一致，口径亦未说明。

figures.source: World Bank, Asian Toll Road Development Program, May 1999, as cited in English Wikipedia, Tate's Cairn Tunnel; Chinese Wikipedia, 大老山隧道

value.en: HK$782 million contract (Dragages–Bachy Soletanche), awarded 1988 — then the Highways Department's largest
value.zh: 合约金额 7.82 亿港元（宝嘉—地基建业联营），1988 年批出，为当时路政署最大的工程合约

timeline.en: The New Hong Kong Tunnel Company wins the Eastern Harbour Crossing franchise in December; the Kwun Tong Bypass is proposed.
timeline.zh: 12 月，新香港隧道有限公司取得东区海底隧道专营权；观塘绕道构想提出。

timeline.en: Work on the Eastern Harbour Crossing begins on 25 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 25 日，东区海底隧道动工。

timeline.en: The last immersed-tube unit of the Eastern Harbour Crossing is placed on 15 September; work on the Tate's Cairn Tunnel begins.
timeline.zh: 9 月 15 日，东隧最后一节沉管安放；大老山隧道动工。

timeline.en: The Eastern Harbour Crossing and the first phase of the Kwun Tong Bypass open on 21 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 21 日，东区海底隧道及观塘绕道第一期通车。

timeline.en: The Kwun Tong Bypass second phase opens on 14 June; the Tate's Cairn Tunnel, Tate's Cairn Highway and the last bypass link open on 26 June, completing the route.
timeline.zh: 6 月 14 日观塘绕道第二期通车；6 月 26 日大老山隧道、大老山公路及观塘绕道最后一段通车，全线贯通。

timeline.en: Route 6 is renumbered Route 2 under the third numbering system.
timeline.zh: 第三代编号系统实施，6号干线改称 2号干线。

timeline.en: The franchise for the Eastern Harbour Crossing's railway tubes expires.
timeline.zh: 东隧铁路隧道专营权届满。

timeline.en: The Eastern Harbour Crossing road tunnel passes to the government on 7 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 7 日，东隧行车隧道交还政府。

timeline.en: The Tate's Cairn Tunnel passes to the government on 11 July.
timeline.zh: 7 月 11 日，大老山隧道移交政府。

timeline.en: HKeToll replaces the toll booths at both tunnels.
timeline.zh: 两条隧道改用“易通行”，收费亭取消。
